enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn to back. Snore. Stretch arms. Open eyes. Look at clock. Sit up in bed.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Turn off water heater. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Check phone. Pack work bag.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through headlines. Tap on article. Read article. Scroll down. Put down phone. Stand up. Stretch arms overhead. Bend forward to touch toes. Do 10 jumping jacks. Sit on floor. Do 10 sit-ups. Stand up. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on patient records and telehealth consultations
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open patient records software. Open patient file. Read patient history. Type notes. Pick up phone. Dial patient number. Speak to patient. Listen to patient. Write down symptoms. End call. Put down phone. Type prescription. Save file. Open next patient file. Read file. Type notes.
Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out food. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place food in microwave. Close microwave. Press start. Open microwave. Take out food. Sit at table. Eat lunch.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on patient records and telehealth consultations
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open patient records software. Open patient file. Read patient history. Type notes. Pick up phone. Dial patient number. Speak to patient. Listen to patient. Write down symptoms. End call. Put down phone. Type prescription. Save file. Open next patient file. Read file. Type notes. Pick up phone.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch show. Pick up phone. Browse social media. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Stretch. Sit back down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot and pan. Close cupboard. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch show. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Browse internet. Watch video. Type message. Send message. Put down laptop. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Play game. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off computer. Stand up.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Change into pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Turn off light. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Snore. Scratch arm. Yawn. Stretch legs.
